adjudication.rationale: The diff introduces a `raw_html` cook method that explicitly bypasses the cooking/sanitization pipeline (`Post#cook` returns `raw` when `cook_method == Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]`). `TopicEmbed.import` creates posts with `cook_method: Post.cook_methods[:raw_html]` and sets `raw` to `absolutize_urls(url, contents)` where `contents` comes from external sources (e.g. `Jobs::PollFeed` uses `SimpleRSS.parse(open(...))` and passes `CGI.unescapeHTML(i.content.scrub)` into `TopicEmbed.import`). The embed view then renders `post.cooked` using `<%= raw post.cooked %>`, which will output that un-sanitized HTML. This is a verifiable stored XSS vector for embedded feed/imported content.
